tools.oneLiner: is a named question on a field, not a prompt in a service.

email.feels?(:urgent)
is a named question on a field, not a prompt in a service.
# Gemfile
gem "jev-feels"
class SupportEmail < ApplicationRecord
include Jev::Model
feels :body, :urgent
feels :subject, :not_important, "Subject of this email is not important"
decide :body, :support_team
validates_feeling :body, :urgent, threshold: 0.9
end
email.feels?(:urgent) # => true
email.decide(:support_team)

The MyA11yReport MCP is a local Model Context Protocol server that gives an AI agent the tools to audit a website: it drives a real Chromium browser with Playwright, runs axe-core, and reads the page’s structure, tab order, images and colors. An agent connects to it over stdio and can then navigate, inspect and report on pages on its own.
